requirements.title: IOLENGTH assigns the unformatted direct-access storage requirement and suitability value
requirements.definition: The IOLENGTH= variable in an INQUIRE by output list is assigned the number of file storage units that would be required to store the output-list data in an unformatted file, and that value shall be suitable as a RECL= value for a matching unformatted direct-access connection.

pending.iolength-assigned-for-output-list: Initialize the IOLENGTH variable to a negative sentinel, inquire a nonempty output list with distinct integer and character objects, and assert that the value becomes positive rather than retaining the sentinel.
pending.iolength-suitable-for-matching-direct-re: Use the returned IOLENGTH value as RECL= for a scratch unformatted direct-access file; write and read a record with objects of the same types, type parameters, extents, and order, and assert IOSTAT zero and exact round-trip values.

requirements.title: IOLENGTH exact storage-unit count is processor dependent
requirements.definition: The particular number of file storage units assigned by IOLENGTH= is processor dependent.

pending.iolength-exact-count-processor-dependent: No portable oracle may compare the exact IOLENGTH number across processors; future tests assert only positivity and suitability for the matching RECL= use.

requirements.title: INQUIRE output lists exclude derived-type items that require defined input/output
requirements.definition: The output list in an INQUIRE statement shall not contain a derived-type list item that requires a defined input/output procedure.

requirements.title: IOLENGTH for ordinary derived-type items assumes no defined input/output invocation
requirements.definition: If a derived-type item appears in an INQUIRE output list without requiring defined input/output, the IOLENGTH value assumes that no defined input/output procedure will be invoked.

pending.iolength-ordinary-derived-item-no-define: Use a simple derived type with only intrinsic components and no defined input/output; obtain IOLENGTH, use it as RECL= for unformatted direct access, and assert IOSTAT zero and component round-trip values.

IOLENGTH assignment and required RECL suitability are portable bounded effects.
The exact storage-unit count is processor dependent.
Derived-type output-list prohibition and ordinary derived-item IOLENGTH assumption are split.
Defines the IOLENGTH assumption for derived-type items that are permitted by the restriction.

review_rationale: Source registration for 12.10.3-12.12: IOLENGTH, error, end-of-record and end-of-file conditions, IOSTAT=, IOMSG=, and restrictions on I/O statements (batch166). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer, accepted with no findings. IOLENGTH's exact count is latitude but its direct-access RECL= suitability is planned; END=/EOR= conditions, IOSTAT_END and IOSTAT_EOR distinctness, zero on success and positive errors are planned portably; IOMSG unchanged on success is planned with a sentinel while condition-message text is never compared. Source accounting only.
